exclusions.reason: a clock reading of the recording run: the recorder replaces it by the token <date> and the replay replaces the listener's Date value by the same token; the header name, its place and its case are compared
exclusions.what: the value of the Date header in wire[].responses[].{raw,head} and timing.timeouts[].responses[].{raw,head}

exclusions.reason: Node's own timers are real in the recording, so they are shortened to keep it to seconds; the bytes sent do not depend on them, and the replay waits timing.defaults (the server's own settings, read from a default server) on its virtual clock
exclusions.what: timing.timeouts[]: the 1000 ms request timeout, 500 ms headers timeout and 100 ms check interval of the recording server

exclusions.reason: Node closes it somewhere in [headersTimeout, headersTimeout + connectionsCheckingInterval] by where the check tick falls; the recorder records only that it was open just before headersTimeout and closed inside that window, and the replay closes at the end of the window (headersTimeoutMs + connectionsCheckingIntervalMs of timing.defaults, read from a default server)
exclusions.what: timing.timeouts[] "a connection that sends no byte": the instant of the close (not recorded) and the 1000/500/100 ms timers

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder
